label: MORNING BRIEF

stories.title: Land officers may pay for errors
stories.story: MPs found double and overlapping titles at six zonal land offices. They want LC leaders and neighbours involved before a title is issued.
stories.you: Expect more checks. Talk to the LC and the neighbours about a plot before you list it.
stories.source: Source: Parliament of Uganda release · 11 Nov 2026

stories.title: Church land sold: nine arrested
stories.story: Police arrested nine people accused of selling parts of a 101-acre Catholic Church plot in Mukono. 29 acres already had squatters.
stories.you: Papers are not enough. Before your client pays, visit the plot and ask the LC who owns it.

stories.title: 600 people fear eviction at Njeru
stories.story: About 600 residents of Nile Landing Site report night attacks to push them off land they have held since 1960. Officials say no eviction is authorised.
stories.you: Families on a plot for decades? Settle with them first, in writing, before you sell.

stories.title: Lubigi wetland worries
stories.story: Wakiso leaders say central land offices decide without consulting them. The council Speaker is worried by reports Lubigi Wetland went to investors.
stories.you: Plot near a swamp? Check it isn’t wetland before you list it. Evictions happen.

stories.title: Power is cheaper and connects faster
stories.story: UEDCL says the tariff fell from about Shs486 to Shs396 a unit. It connected about 80,000 customers in two months.
stories.you: Power helps rentals. Ask landlords to get the meter connected before viewings.
